messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, that's the issue. 2G networks are generally not suitable for MMS. You need to change your network mode preference to allow your phone to connect to faster networks like 4G or 5G.

Please run: `set_network_mode_preference(mode="4g_5g_preferred")`

This will allow your phone to connect to the best available network. It's a safe change and won't affect your calls or data. After you do this, let me know and we'll continue with the next step.

I changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred. The status bar now shows a strong 5G signal, but I noticed the mobile data icon is showing disabled. What should I do next? This is all a bit confusing for me.

Please discuss the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
